newsitem.title: USA: Productivity new foreign orders $14.3 mln.
newsitem.headline: Productivity new foreign orders $14.3 mln.

text.p: Productivity Technologies Corp said new foreign orders received by its operating subsidiary, Atlas Technologies, in fiscal 1997 totaled $14.3 million, accelerating in the fourth fiscal quarter.
International customers represented 40 percent of fiscal 1997 new orders, compared to 12 percent a year earlier, the company said.
New orders were received from foreign customers in Brazil, China, France, Poland, and the U.K., the company said.

The company issued a news release saying the increase in international orders indicated the company's global leadership in stamping press automation, pointing to the partnership with its automotive and other customers to improve efficiency and quality of manufacturing.
